metadata.database: A Deeper China | Quanzhou–Dehua decision layer

QZM01.guest_need: A visitor wants Quanzhou as a world-port system of production, transport, belief and trade.
QZM01.hidden_need: Replace a temple list with one maritime-system question.
QZM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One port-system route explains Quanzhou better than collecting religious sites.
QZM01.stop_condition: The visitor can connect production, port, belief and movement.
QZM01.low_energy_branch: Use one public port/old-city route and an indoor anchor.
QZM01.body_cost: Moderate walking with heat, crowds and attention load.

QZM02.guest_need: A visitor wants religious plurality with respectful etiquette.
QZM02.hidden_need: Avoid consuming worship as spectacle or treating all sites as interchangeable.
QZM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One carefully framed comparison is deeper than a temple/mosque checklist.
QZM02.stop_condition: The visitor understands one belief/community relationship and follows site rules.
QZM02.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking, high etiquette and crowd sensitivity.

QZM03.guest_need: A visitor wants port, gate, bridge and river-sea movement made visible.
QZM03.hidden_need: Translate maritime history into physical infrastructure.
QZM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One infrastructure sequence adds trade movement that another temple cannot.
QZM03.stop_condition: The visitor can explain one connection between gate, bridge, river and port.
QZM03.body_cost: Moderate walking with heat and route continuity risk.

QZM04.guest_need: A visitor wants Nanyin, tea, food and streets as lived cultural context.
QZM04.hidden_need: Match current programme and consent rather than promise a performance.
QZM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One sound/food/public-life question makes old-city culture legible.
QZM04.stop_condition: One sound, meal or street rhythm has been understood.
QZM04.low_energy_branch: Choose one confirmed food/tea or public performance layer.

QZM05.guest_need: A visitor wants Dehua as a ceramic production/design system, buying or verified making.
QZM05.hidden_need: Separate museum, showroom, purchase and maker experience.
QZM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One production-system question is more useful than a craft-shopping circuit.
QZM05.stop_condition: Purpose, access and partner release are clear.
QZM05.body_cost: Transfer and language/supplier sensitivity are high.

QZM06.guest_need: A visitor wants to avoid confusing a route with authentication or artist booking.
QZM06.hidden_need: Set purchase, shipping, provenance and experience boundaries.
QZM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A clear boundary protects the visitor more than another showroom.
QZM06.stop_condition: The visitor knows what is independent purchase and what is not verified.
QZM06.body_cost: Low walking, high commercial and shipping sensitivity.

QZM07.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide whether Dehua deserves a separate day.
QZM07.hidden_need: Prevent a two-day Quanzhou plan from becoming a rushed city-plus-factory trip.
QZM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A pacing decision protects Quanzhou’s maritime story and Dehua’s production story from being diluted.
QZM07.stop_condition: The visitor accepts a separate day and transfer purpose.
QZM07.rain_branch: Use current transport and indoor programme before moving.

QZM08.guest_need: A visitor needs dates, payment, transport and sacred/craft access to work.
QZM08.hidden_need: Prevent a rich cultural route from failing on foreign-visitor friction.
QZM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A friction audit protects the route better than adding another temple.
QZM08.stop_condition: The visitor can pay, navigate, enter respectfully and recover.
QZM08.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high operational sensitivity.
